newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan reforms needed to prevent forex swings -- EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan reforms needed to prevent forex swings -- EPA.

text.p: Economic reforms are needed in Japan to prevent wild fluctuations in exchange rates, Economic Planning Agency (EPA) Minister Shusei Tanaka told a news conference on Tuesday.
Commenting on the dollar's recent rises against the yen, Tanaka said the currency moves reflected uncertainty over how the government would undertake administrative and structural reforms.
"We will remain vigilant about exchange rate moves. We have to tackle structural reforms seriously in order to prevent wild and rapid fluctuations in exchange rates," Tanaka said.
